🎬 Bruiser (2022) — Drama
Darious is a 14-year-old boy spending the summer away from home when he becomes fascinated by Porter, a mysterious man who seems to understand the struggles he is going through. After Darious has a difficult encounter with his father, his growing connection with Porter forces him to look at his family and himself in a completely different way.
As their relationship develops, Darious begins learning about strength, masculinity, anger, and what it really means to stand up for yourself. But Porter carries his own painful history, and the lessons he gives Darious become complicated as the young boy struggles to understand which path is right for him.
The film explores fatherhood, identity, masculinity, trauma, forgiveness, and the complicated ways people deal with anger. Darious is caught between wanting to prove himself and trying to understand the adults shaping his life.
More than just a coming-of-age drama, Bruiser is a thoughtful story about a young person learning that true strength isn't always about fighting back—it can also mean understanding yourself and choosing what kind of person you want to become. ❤️‍🩹
💬 Do you think strength comes from standing up to others, or from learning to control yourself? 👇
